description: Runtime-only ComfyUI quality manifest: interpolation, depth parallax, upscale, LTX-Video/AnimateDiff motion control and per-recipe prompt/LoRA hints. Data only — no workflow graphs, no scheduler or job wiring.

items.purpose: 2× frame interpolation of AI-generated clips so motion reads smoother
items.notes: Author recommends 4.24+ for diffusion video. MIT code and weights still stay runtime-only here — this manifest never vendors models.

items.purpose: Large-motion frame interpolation between distant keyframes
items.model: FILM: Frame Interpolation for Large Motion (google-research)
items.notes: Apache-2.0 is outside the vendor allowlist; runtime-only by policy. Pair with Practical-RIFE for short smooths vs large gaps.

items.purpose: Monocular depth maps for 2.5D parallax of stills
items.notes: Depth feeds layer z; camera translate scales as 1/z. Apache-2.0 code and weights — runtime-only, never vendored.

items.purpose: 4× spatial upscale of stills and low-resolution plates before motion
items.notes: BSD-3-Clause code is outside the vendor allowlist and each checkpoint's own weight licence must be verified before use; runtime-only.

items.purpose: Image-to-video motion for short plates
items.notes: Apache-2.0 covers the code; verify each checkpoint's own weight licence before use. Runtime-only, never vendored.

items.purpose: Next-generation image-to-video family — recorded for awareness only
items.notes: Restricted: community licence with a revenue cap; excluded from this feature unless an explicit licence review clears it.

items.purpose: Camera-motion control through motion LoRAs on stills pipelines
items.notes: Apache-2.0 code; check each motion LoRA card before use — many community LoRAs carry OpenRAIL terms. Runtime-only, never vendored.
